svg.title: Terraform remote state backend on AWS S3 with native state locking
svg.desc: An AWS account holds two regions. In the primary region, us-east-1, the Terraform backend's S3 bucket is versioned and encrypted and holds two objects: terraform.tfstate and the lock file terraform.tfstate.tflock, so no DynamoDB table is needed for locking. S3 replication copies them to a backup bucket in a greyed-out standby disaster recovery region, us-west-2. Three engineers and a CI/CD pipeline that runs terraform apply connect to the backend from outside the account.
